tools.name: generate_document
tools.description: Generate a vector PDF from document details. HTTP calls can return a temporary download link. Configured customer sync can save contact details and start follow-up. See https://pressmark.dev/privacy.

tools.name: preview_document
tools.description: Render a PNG preview from supplied document details. HTTP calls can return a temporary image link.

tools.name: calculate_totals
tools.description: Compute subtotal, tax, discount, grand total, and balance due from document items. Stateless.

tools.name: convert_document
tools.description: Convert document details to an invoice, estimate, receipt, credit note, or refund PDF. HTTP calls can return a temporary download link.

tools.name: record_payment
tools.description: Create a receipt or updated invoice from supplied payment details. Does not charge or verify payment. HTTP calls can return a temporary download link.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Send a bug report, feature request, or general feedback to the private Pressmark inbox when the user asks. Include only details they choose to share; omit documents, passwords, and tokens.

tools.name: get_feedback_status
tools.description: Check one Pressmark report using its report ID and private access key. Returns its review status without exposing the report text or contact details.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_feedback" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_feedback_status · Private data: generate_document, preview_document, calculate_totals, convert_document, record_payment, submit_feedback, get_feedback_status · Public sink: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_feedback_status · Private data: generate_document, preview_document, calculate_totals, convert_document, record_payment, submit_feedback, get_feedback_status · Public sink: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "generate_document" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Statelessly synthesize a vector PDF document (invoice, receipt, contract, NDA, or lease) in <25ms without mutating server records. Example: doc_type='invoice', generate_document({"doc_type":"invoice","from":{"name":"Acme"},"to":{"name":"Client"}})" → after: "Generate a vector PDF from document details. HTTP calls can return a temporary download link. Configured customer sync can save contact details and start follow-up. See https://pressmark.dev/privacy."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
